title: Architectural Design Sync Integration
business: A distributed architectural firm managing complex client feedback loops across multiple time zones.
problem: Project leads lose significant billable hours manually reconciling verbal feedback from recorded client meetings with technical scratchpad notes and pending action items.
solution: By integrating the Wispr Flow connector, Claude gains direct access to the firm's meeting transcripts and scratchpad notes, allowing it to synthesize disparate verbal feedback into unified technical requirements without manual data migration.
steps: Authenticate the Wispr Flow connector within the Claude interface using the provided API endpoint.
Authorize Claude to access meeting transcripts and scratchpad notes via the Wispr Flow account permissions.
Instruct Claude to query the specific meeting series using search_meetings to identify client feedback.
Use search_scratchpad_notes to cross-reference verbal feedback with existing design constraints.
Execute update_task to synchronize the finalized action items back into the project management workflow.
outcome: Project leads achieve a cohesive view of client requirements, ensuring that verbal feedback is captured as actionable technical tasks immediately after meetings.
limitation: The connector relies on the quality of the initial transcript; if the meeting audio is poor, Claude may hallucinate or miss critical details, which can be verified by manually checking the source transcript via the get_meeting tool.
